en.name: Lostream Record
en.effect: Excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck. You can add up to 2 excavated WIND Attribute Sea Serpent Type monsters to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. If you added 2 monsters to your hand by this effect, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. This turn, you can only attack with WIND Attribute Sea Serpent Type monsters.
